text:
I understand you'd like to know about the bluetooth speaker from your order, but I need your order ID to look up the specific details. Without the order ID, I can't access your order information to see which speaker you purchased or its price and battery life.

You might be able to find your order ID in:
- Your email confirmation
- Your account dashboard on our website
- Any shipping notifications you received

Once you have your order ID, I'll be able to look up all the details about your bluetooth speaker and provide you with the price and battery life information you're looking for.
zh:
我理解您想了解您订单中的蓝牙音箱，但我需要您的订单号来查询具体信息。没有订单号，我无法访问您的订单信息以查看您购买了哪款音箱及其价格和电池寿命。

您可能可以在以下地方找到您的订单号：
- 您的电子邮件确认
- 我们网站上的账户面板
- 您收到的任何运输通知

一旦您有了订单号，我就能查询您蓝牙音箱的所有详细信息，并提供您想要的价格和电池寿命信息。
